description: The Flying Brick Visual allows you to create Flying Brick charts (also known as a Floating Brick chart or Waterfall chart) in Power BI without manually massaging the data as is customarily done in Excel. Typically when creating a Flying Brick in Excel you must create a special hidden series in order to get the column chart to look like a Flying Brick chart. Those extra steps are done for you in the background with the Flying Brick Visual. Release Notes 1.0.5 - added ability format value labels - additional x-axis label options 1.0.4 - Initial Release
